scheme_name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Capital Subsidy (Fiscal Incentives to Labour Intensive Unit)
other_conditions: Industrial unit must be recognised as a Labour Intensive Unit – either a new unit employing a minimum of 4,000 persons (at least 1,000 female) registered under the EPF scheme, or an existing unit expanding/diversifying that creates at least 4,000 new jobs with the same female employment minimum.
The unit must have availed a term loan for the project.
Commercial production must commence before applying for subsidy disbursement.
The application must be submitted within one year from the Date of Commercial Production (DoCP).
Total subsidy received (State + Central) must not exceed the total term loan amount disbursed.

Eligible activities include: Garments, Apparel & Made‑ups, Technical Textiles (including Composite Unit); Weaving (with or without preparatory), Knitting, Dyeing & Processing, Texturising, Twisting, Embroidery; and MMF Spinning to manufacture yarn from Polyester Staple Fiber (PSF) / Viscose Staple Fiber (VSF) (excluding cotton and synthetic filament yarn spinning).
benefits_summary: Capital subsidy of up to 35% (or 30%/25% depending on location category) of eligible fixed capital investment, capped at INR 150 crore per unit.
